scenes.script:
Arun says: Nammal airport counter-il English samsaarikyendi varumbol freeze aayi pogaarundo?
Arun says: Veruthe point cheythu "Give me ticket" enn parayumo?
Arun says: Adhu bhayangara embarrassing aanu.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Airport-il freeze aavundo?
"Give me ticket" enn parayumo?
Bhayangara embarrassing aanu

scenes.script:
Arun says: Kochi-yil ninno Bangalore-il ninno aadyamaayi flight kayarumbol English samsaarikyanam enn ariyamallo.
Arun says: Pakshe ippo adhu oru big deal alla.
Arun says: Njan Supernova AI app vazhi Miss Nova-yodoppam practice cheyyarundu.
Arun says: Avar ente level check cheythu enikkaayi personalized plan ready aakkum.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Kochi-yil ninno Bangalore-il ninno flight kayarundo?
English samsaarikyanam
Miss Nova personalized plan ready aakkum
Enikkaayi mathram

scenes.script:
Arun says: Ithile best part, aarum nammale nokki judge cheyyilla ennadhaan.
Arun says: Nammal avarodu out loud samsaarikyumbol, mistakes appol thanne correct cheyyum.
Arun says: Bag pack cheyyunnadhinu munpu thanne real-life airport situations practice cheyyam.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Aarum judge cheyyilla
Out loud samsaarikyu
Real-life airport situations practice cheyyam

scenes.script:
Arun says: Avar logic Malayalathil explain cheyyunnadhukondu kaaryangal easy-aayi manassilaagum.
Arun says: Udaharanathinu, "Where is the luggage counter?"
Arun says: Alledhil, "Where will I get the boarding pass from?"
Arun says: Innum paranjaal, "Where is the toilet here?"
scenes.on_screen_text:
"Where is the luggage counter?"
"Where will I get the boarding pass from?"
"Where is the toilet here?"

scenes.script:
Arun says: Airport-il chodhyangal chodhikaan pediyundengil, ini aa tension venda.
Arun says: Manikyoorugal scroll cheyyunnadhu nirthi, divusavum just 15 minutes practice cheyyu.
Arun says: Innu thanne Supernova AI download cheythu confidently samsaarikyu.

Chodhikaan pediyundo?
Manikyoorugal scroll cheyyunnadhu nirthu

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied all Malayalam-specific rules: used 'samsaarikkyuka' instead of 'speak cheyyuka', replaced 'hours' with 'manikyoorugal' and 'day' with 'divusavum' as per the Malayalam time-unit override. Re-casted 'Rahul' to 'Arun', and the cities 'Mumbai or Delhi' to 'Kochi or Bangalore' to fit the region naturally. Ensured the hook opens with the native word 'Nammal' to capture immediate attention, while keeping all quoted English lines strictly verbatim.

safety.summary: The script is fully compliant with all brand-safety guardrails, successfully resolving the initial situational anxiety into confident speaking without any policy violations.
